column1: # Outcome rates for the sex and age bins scenario.
# at the top to show the filter columns that look at who or what infected a
# person. Rows are matched first to last and the first match wins
# specific rows have to sit above the general ones they overlap.
#   filter.transmission_mode   a transmission mode named in disease.yaml
#   filter.infector_symptom    the infector's symptom tag at the moment of
#   filter.properties.<name>   a person property from the world (a list-valued
#                              property matches on one exact member)
# A filter on the infector's symptom or on the transmission mode does not match
# a seeded case unless the seed states those facts itself (see
# infection_seeds.yaml). Seeds that do not fall through to the age and sex rows
# Every row must sum to 1 across its outcome columns.
